Lease-end choices

The leasing company retains legal title to the vehicle throughout the lease. The customer must make each monthly payment by its due date.

At the scheduled end date, the customer may purchase the vehicle for the purchase amount stated in the lease-end notice, or return it to an authorized location. If the customer returns the vehicle, the customer is responsible for mileage above the contracted allowance and for damage beyond ordinary wear.

To request early termination, contact us for a payoff quote; the lease remains active and monthly payments remain due until the vehicle is returned and the account is settled.
